prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no singing, no lyrics. Medieval chiptune. 8-bit console sound playing early music: a square-wave lead that phrases like a recorder or a shawm, a plucked pulse-wave lute arpeggio, a triangle-wave drone like a hurdy-gurdy, noise-channel tabor drum and tambourine. Modal melody in Dorian or Mixolydian, an estampie or a galliard dance feel, a castle court, minstrels, a tournament. Crunchy retro chip timbres, no modern synth pads, no orchestra. Background music for the build phase of a cheerful castle board game: the player stacks painted wooden wall pieces on a tile board, friendly and quick, sunlit toy fortress by the sea. Tempo: 108 BPM. Mood: calm, bouncy, curious, light. Arrangement: a steady loop of a catchy eight-bar melody with a second eight bars that answers it, a light counter-melody, no big build-up, no breakdown, no ending, constant energy so it loops. About 90 seconds long.
